stock.description: Tailam Tech Construction Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity, is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of key building materials within the People's Republic of China. The company's offerings encompass pre-stressed high-strength concrete piles, ready-mix concrete, and lightweight ceramsite concrete blocks. It primarily furnishes these products to real estate developers and construction companies, with a particular focus on the Jiangsu province. These materials are widely utilized across a spectrum of construction undertakings, including residential and commercial developments, bridges, railway systems, port infrastructure, public works, and various large-scale projects. Established in 2011, the firm's corporate headquarters are situated in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
